chunks: The people of 'Ad accused the messengers of lies.

key_terms.عَادٌ: The tribe of 'Ad, an ancient Arab people known in Islamic tradition

ai.seo_question: Who were the people of 'Ad and how did they respond to the messengers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the pattern of divine punishment for those who arrogantly reject clear signs, paralleling the fate of the Prophet Hud. It underscores the continuity of the prophetic mission, linking the ancient tribe of 'Ad to the broader Quranic narrative of monotheism versus idolatry.
